decisions.statement: Project deletion lives in a Delete project section on the project overview page
Deleting a project keeps its conversations, messages, and raw sources

assumptions.statement: The same conversation can back several projects

decisions.statement: The project cascade is the inverse of the existing deleteConversation: drop the lens, keep the primary sources
Project-scoped rows are deleted one by one so the sync engine emits a tombstone per row

assumptions.statement: Deleting an unknown project id is a no-op

decisions.statement: Confirmation is an inline alertdialog on the page that says conversations are not deleted
Deletion is permanent — no soft delete, undo, or audit record
An incoming project tombstone from sync runs the same cascade on the receiving device
